newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra, forestry drag Swedish shares to lower close.
newsitem.headline: Astra, forestry drag Swedish shares to lower close.

text.p: Share prices fell on Wednesday after a surprise interest rate increase in Britain and heavy selling pushed drug company Astra two percent lower.
The general market index fell 0.87 percent to 2,104.94 and more losses were seen likely on Thursday in the wake of weaker U.S. and British debt markets.
"A natural correction could take us far below (current levels)," one broker said.
Astra closed six crowns lower at 297 following moves on Wall Street. Telecoms group Ericsson fell 1.50 crowns to 178.50.
Rate sensitive shares slid after debt markets weakened.
Insurance company Skandia closed three crowns lower at 186.50 after touching 184. Construction company Skanska fell four crowns to 275.
Nordbanken bucked the trend and rose 1.50 crowns to 168.50 after posting a nine-month operating profit of 5.74 billion crowns, a 13 percent increase over the same 1995 period.

The forestry sector index fell 1.4 percent. SCA said it planned to increase coated fine paper prices in Germany by 10 percent but said it will probably have to cut newsprint prices before the end of the year.
